Senior Python Backend Engineers to design, build, and scale our backend and cloud infrastructure. You'll own features end-to-end from async API design and data modeling to deployment on AWS — with architectural and leadership scope growing with your seniority.

What You'll Do

Build and own REST APIs and real-time WebSocket services in FastAPI (async-first).
Write performant async Python backed by PostgreSQL (asyncpg), SQLAlchemy 2.0 / SQLModel, and Alembic migrations.
Design schemas, optimize queries, and reason about indexing, pooling, and scale.
Architect async/background workloads with Redis and AWS SQS.
Deploy and operate on AWS (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, EC2) with Docker; Terraform/IaC for senior folks.
Implement auth, security, and multi-tenancy (JWT, OAuth2, RBAC, session/cookie auth).
Contribute to AI-native features — vector search (pgvector + embeddings) and LLM/RAG integration.
Uphold quality via pytest, clean code (black/ruff/mypy), and code review; mentor and shape standards at the senior end.

We're Hiring: Full Stack Developer




Remote (First Month) Relocation to Bengaluru or Pune (Based on Business Requirements)
Experience: 2 to 4 Years

About the Company

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Lead - Full-Stack Developer to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, developing, and maintaining our web applications. You will work across the entire technology stack, creating responsive and intuitive user interfaces with Angular and building robust, scalable backend services and APIs using Node.js and Python. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong foundation in software engineering principles and a passion for writing clean, efficient code.

About the Role

The responsibilities for this role include developing dynamic, responsive, and high-performance single-page applications using Angular (v16+). You will create reusable and modular components and services following Angular best practices, implement state management solutions such as NgRx, Akita, or services with RxJS, and ensure that UI/UX designs are technically feasible and implemented with high fidelity. You will also be responsible for writing unit and end-to-end tests using Jasmine, Karma, and Protractor or Cypress.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable server-side logic using Node.js (with frameworks such as Express.js or NestJS) and Python (with frameworks such as Django or Flask).
Develop and consume RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
Integrate with various data storage solutions including SQL and NoSQL databases and caching systems.
Implement schema design and optimizations.
Integrate front-end applications with back-end services and third-party APIs, ensuring seamless data flow and functionality across the entire stack.
Collaborate with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines, containerization using Docker, and cloud deployment on Azure.
Lead the team and work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Participate in code reviews to maintain high code quality and share knowledge.
Contribute to architectural decisions and advocate for best practices.

Qualifications

Graduate or above.
At least 10 years of professional experience in full-stack web development.

Required Skills

Proven experience with Angular, with strong skills in TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern CSS preprocessors such as SASS/SCSS.
Experience in JavaScript, RxJS, and asynchronous programming.
Strong proficiency in Node.js and its ecosystem (npm, Express.js, etc.).
Proficiency in Python with frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
Solid understanding of API design principles, including REST, security, and HTTP protocols.
Experience with both SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL and NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
Proficient with Git, agile development methodologies, and test-driven development.
Strong problem-solving abilities, effective communication skills, and a collaborative team spirit.

Preferred Skills

Experience with serverless architectures.
Knowledge of microservices.
Familiarity with DevOps tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure.
Understanding of web security best practices including OWASP Top 10, JWT, and OAuth.
Additional experience with front-end frameworks such as React or Vue.js.
Knowledge of GraphQL with Apollo or Relay.

Description:

We operate in an agentic engineering environment. This means our small, impactful teams own problems end-to-end, actively leverage AI agents within our workflows to supercharge velocity, and maintain a rigorous TDD (Test-Driven Development) discipline to ensure quality never takes a backseat to speed. If you thrive in high-trust, fast-moving environments and pride yourself on writing clean, robust code across both Node.js and browser environments, we want to talk to you.

Experience: 7–8 years of full-stack engineering experience delivering enterprise-grade or high-traffic web applications.
Frontend Excellence: Deep mastery of React and its modern ecosystem (React Query, Zustand, React Hook Form, React Router, Vite, and data-dense UI tools like AG Grid).
Backend Versatility: Expert in TypeScript/NestJS, alongside professional proficiency in Python (comfortable using Pytest, writing clean APIs, and handling data integrations).

Job Summary:
We are seeking a highly skilled and self-motivated Full Stack Engineer with strong experience in AWS cloud services or Spring boot backend development (Node.js, Python, or Java), and frontend frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js). You will play a key role in designing, developing, and scaling modern web applications in a cloud-native environment.
Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications (front-end and back-end).
Architect and implement microservices or serverless functions using AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, etc.).
Build responsive UIs using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue).
Integrate with AWS services like S3, DynamoDB, RDS, SNS/SQS, and CloudWatch.
Implement CI/CD pipelines and ensure smooth deployment using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, etc.
Ensure application security, performance, and scalability.
Collaborate with DevOps and QA teams for automated testing, monitoring, and releases.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and sprint planning.

Must-Have Qualifications:

Bachelor's/Masters degree in Computer Science or related field.
1.5+ years of professional full stack development experience.
Strong knowledge of one backend language (Node.js, Python, Java).
Experience with a modern frontend framework (React preferred).
Proficiency in REST APIs, GraphQL, and web sockets.
Experience with version control (Git) and agile methodologies.

Nice-to-Have Skills:

Familiarity with containerization (Docker, ECS, EKS).
Experience working with AWS services (EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, API Gateway, CloudFormation, etc.)
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
Exposure to NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB).
Experience in monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Datadog, ELK Stack).
AWS Certification (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect) is a plus.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
As our Backend Engineer, you will be reporting directly to our Engineering Manager and will work closely with our Product team to develop new products, scale existing ones and manage deployments and architecture. You wont just take tickets here.
Youll dig into how the system actually works, ask why before how, and chase a problem past the surface to the real cause. Curiosity isnt a nice-to-have on this team, its how we build.
WHAT YOU LL OWN:
Design, build and maintain APIs, services and systems and debug production issues across multiple levels of the stack.
Collaborate closely with our Business, Product and Data Science teams to understand and solve customer pain points at scale.
Design, Develop, Implement and Deploy enterprise level, high availability web application platforms, with support from the design team at Portcast.
Create a technology infrastructure that functions well at scale. You will design and improve the system architecture.
Own end-to-end the design AND implementation of how our product handles real-time data at scale, from event ingestion across dozens of carrier sources, through data normalization, through ML-powered risk and ETA models, to the user-visible recommendations our enterprise customers act on.
Build features customers actually use, harden internal tooling the team relies on, and create the alerting and monitoring surfaces that catch issues before customers do. Youre a builder first, with the judgment to know whats worth building.
Make architecture trade-offs explicit and defensible.
Instrument what you build, find real bottlenecks, and pick fixes that survive the next 10 of growth, not just the next sprint. You measure before you optimize, and your numbers are reproducible.
WHAT WE RE LOOKING FOR:
Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience in the field.
Work Experience: Minimum 4+ years of experience in a technical role designing, developing and releasing technical solutions and building production systems.
Built or Architected at Scale: Youve either been an early engineering hire at a startup where you took a technical product from scratch to scale, OR youve owned real system design at a FAANG-tier engineering org, defended architectural decisions in actual design reviews, not just contributed to someone elses blueprint. Either path counts! Wed love to hear the learnings and the trade-offs youd make differently today.
First Principles Thinker: When you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You dont reach for a new framework when a tighter use of an existing tool would do the job.
Curious by Default: You dig deeper instead of following instructions to the letter. When something in the system surprises you, you chase the why, not just the fix. You treat every layer of the stack as something worth understanding, and you ask the good questions early.
